course.title: Flask — From Beginner to Professional Practice
course.description: A visual-first Flask curriculum following the attached 21-module, 237-lesson syllabus. It progresses from routing and templates to data, accounts, APIs, testing, security, deployment, reliability and advanced internals; optional integrations remain clearly separated from Flask core.
course.version_scope: Baseline checked 2026-10-19: Flask 3.1.x. The official Flask changelog lists 3.1.3 released 2026-02-18. Version-specific behavior and optional extension compatibility must be verified against current official documentation before publication.
audience: developers learning WSGI web application architecture
prerequisites: Basic Python syntax, functions, modules, dictionaries, exceptions and file handling are recommended.
HTML, HTTP and SQL familiarity helps, but introductory lessons explain web basics.
Use modules in order for the core course; specialist integrations have separate prerequisites.
learning_outcomes: Build modular Flask applications with routes, HTTP methods, request/response handling and Jinja templates.
Validate forms and API input, manage configuration and sessions, and use safe authentication/authorization patterns.
Persist data with SQLite or selected SQLAlchemy ecosystem tools and design reliable migrations and queries.
Develop JSON APIs and safe file workflows; evaluate optional extensions and external services.
Test application behavior, address common web security risks, measure performance, deploy using a production WSGI server, and plan monitoring and recovery.
